pick_word.subtitle: Help Kenji with the tools for the car!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What was the best prank in this episode?
Have you ever pulled off a prank?

nodes.text: Howard heroically dives in front of Linda, pushing her out of the way!
The balloons soar by harmlessly as Alexei drives off!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww... My hero.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No one messes with my girl!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hah! Thanks, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can't believe Alexei is pulling a prank like this.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now, first things first. We'll clean up your car, and then we'll figure out how to get your sound system back in order.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Linda, I don't know the first thing about wiring or sound systems...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, don't worry. It just so happens that I know a guy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't like the sound of this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry, man. It's all going to be fine.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's the party van, Howard. The party van! This isn't some third-rate rent-a-bus! This isn't your dad's minivan!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My dad doesn't have a minivan...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This van stands for something greater than any of us... It stands for the right to party.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now look at it. This is all my fault!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The van was innocent! How could I let it get involved in this horrible war?!
Hector falls to his knees in front of the van.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whyyyy?!
Linda darts over and pulls Hector to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Snap out of it, man!
Linda slaps Hector across the face!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Thanks. I needed that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I hate to say it, Howard, but maybe you'd better leave the pep talks to someone else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You... You might be right about that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But the party van...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stop. Before you say anything, I want you to think about Alexei. Just imagine his smug face... He's probably laughing over this right now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's probably thinking that he crushed your spirit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you want him to be right? Do you want to let him win?! Do you want to let him get away with this?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! I want to make him pay for this!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll make him regret the day he played his first prank!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And here's how we're going to do it.
And after a few more hours of planning...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, so everyone knows where we're meeting?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. And I'll drive. There'll be plenty of room in the Party Van, and you guys can check out the killer sound system I just put in!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, good. Let's do this.
That night at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Here's the parking lot! Let's start painting.
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay! I know that took a long time, but this is definitely going to be worth it!
The next day at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Stiletto! What are you doing?! You smacked your car door against my convertible!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Your car's parked over the line!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I can't get out of my car! Help!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: There's something very suspicious about this... It has all the signs of a prank.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You mean Centerscore High actually pulled off a prank?!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: No one messes with my car and gets away with it!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Help meee!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I believe what this calls for is some payback.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There's the fountain!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Quick, pour in the green stuff so we can leave the scene of the crime!
Howard and Hector pour in ten pounds of powdered mix!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, now let's get out of here!
The next day at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What is this?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: It looks like a jiggling mess of bright green gelatin! There's only one school lame enough to pull a prank like this.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You mean Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: But... What did they think this was going to do? I mean, it's just a green mess...
Suddenly, Skazz bursts up out of the gelatin!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Slurp! This is... The best day... Ever!
Skazz opens his mouth wide and dives back in!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Whatever. The point is that right now they think they've won! We've got to do something to get back at them.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Oh, we'll have our revenge...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I'll analyze the tire treads left on the parking lot so we can figure out exactly who's behind this and be sure to pay them back double.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Excellent, Steph. As the leader of the nerds, your technical prowess will be invaluable.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Alexei, as a general practice, I usually try not to associate with you... But in this case, I'll make an exception.
The next day after school, Hector, Howard, Brendan, and Linda find the cars in the Centerscore parking lot covered with melted marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The Party Van! It's... It's...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's been vandalized?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, this is no time for puns.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It looks like they covered all of our cars in marshmallows! That's the oldest trick in the book. Usually Alexei shows more imagination...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's that sound? Is that music?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It looks like they replaced your sound system with a boom box programmed to play this song on repeat... Isn't that the song that ice cream trucks play?
Just then the twins run by!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ice cream!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't have any ice cream!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Then marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We'll take what we can get.
The two little girls tackle the van and start chomping on the marshmallows.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard! Get your sisters off the party van! They're going to bite through the fender...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, girls. Leave Hector's car alone. You're going to ruin your dinner. It can't be good to just eat a bunch of melted marshmallows.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard's right, Kel. Let's go get some graham crackers and chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: S'mores!
The twins run off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great, this is what the party van has been reduced to...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I knew this would happen... This is why I didn't want to get involved in this silly prank war.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, from now on, you can count me out of it.
Brendan leaves.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First the party van... Now Brendan... The team is falling apart!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, man. I've got to snap Hector out of it. Should I reassure him about the party van or get him fired up for revenge?
Howard clumsily tries to dive in front of Linda...
But instead crashes to the ground as the onslaught of balloons soars straight into her!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ouch!
Howard jumps up, ready to defend Linda... But the damage has been done! Linda is covered in honey. Alexei drives off laughing.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yuck. This is seriously a strange prank.
Howard, Hector, and Kenji work together to get the hood off the car.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Good, we're going to start with the engine.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now, the car doors. Howard, help me with this one while Hector takes off the other.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And now, the seats...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not bad, you guys.
Soon, Alexei's car is in pieces, and the boys load it into the Party Van.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hand me that tire iron, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Here.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This is a wrench!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fine! Uh... How about this one?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This is a can opener! You're hopeless!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, I'm trying to help!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, sure! I bet you want this whole thing to fail so I'll look bad in front of Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda isn't even here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! Stop it! Both of you! You're wasting time!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Just stay out of the way! I'll do this myself.
Kenji takes apart the engine...
Then the car doors...
And then the seats...
An hour later, the car is finally in pieces in Hector's van...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: There! Finally done.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I thought we were meeting at Alexei's place!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh... We're not meeting here? Okay. What? Not for another two hours? I guess I got the time wrong too...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'll meet you guys there in a few hours, then.
Steve walks off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did you hear that? Alexei and his thugs are already up to something!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And we've left Centerscore completely defenseless!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't worry. It sounds like we're not too late.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Since I'm on the Spirit Committee, I've got a key to the school. I can go back and ambush them once they get there!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good thinking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a minute, Linda. Are you sure you want to go off by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry. I'm not afraid of Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just be careful. I don't want anything to happen to you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww, it's sweet of you to worry, but when I see them, I'll send you a text. You guys can come charging in if I need backup.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about getting back across to the Wilson High side of town?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't worry, I'll just take a taxi. It's totally safe to travel by car around here. I heard that Spike took his little brother here over Thanksgiving, and they got back using a taxi.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now you three should get to work! This car isn't going to take itself apart...
Linda heads back to Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: All right, let's start. This is pretty complicated, and if you get the order of what we're doing mixed up, it'll be impossible to put the car back together.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So pay attention to what we're doing. Hopefully you guys won't get in the way.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we can help.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Really? Okay, Howard, hand me the wrench.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You know which one is the wrench, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course I do!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Easy, man. We're all on the same team here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got to get along with Kenji... For the good of the team...

rounds.subtitle: Help Kenji with the tools for the car!
Help Kenji with the tools for the car!

nodes.text: They all duck down behind Alexei's car...
Just as Steve walks by on the other side of the car!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was close! It's a good thing we ducked down!
They hear Steve talking on his cell phone...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Hey, Darren! Where are you?
Steve spots the four of them standing by Alexei's car.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Hey! What are you guys doing here? Aren't you from Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, we, uh... We lost a bet to Alexei, so we have to wash his car!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh... Centerscore losers. This I've got to see.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, you heard him, guys. We'd better start cleaning...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm not washing some Wilson kid's car.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on, Kenji. We wouldn't want Steve to think that we're here `for some other reason.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Kenji. We wouldn't want Steve to think that we're here [color=#3b78e2][i]for some other reason.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: One car wash later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That took forever.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Haha... Not bad. You guys do good work.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I guess I'll see you dorks later.
Steve's phone rings, and he answers it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's get to work. We can meet up at Howard's place once the car is fixed.
Later that night, Hector, Howard, Linda, and Kenji meet to discuss the prank...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, get your game face on, boys... And Linda. We need something `horrible` to do to those Wilson High chumps.
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, get your game face on, boys... And Linda. We need something [color=#e23b3b][i]horrible[/i][/color] to do to those Wilson High chumps.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The prank we're going to pull... It's got to be something big... Something amazing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, Hector? I know you really love this van, but don't let your personal feelings get in the way of the mission, all right? Whatever we do, we can't take it too far...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure, sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you know what they say... Turn-about is fair play. How about we take apart Alexei's car?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know... Where's the clever twist?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What if we put it back together inside the Wilson High gym?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's genius!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh... Alexei won't know what hit him.
An hour later, Hector, Howard, Linda, and Kenji meet up outside Alexei's house.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, team. There's Alexei's car. Let's take it apart.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Here, we'll start with the wheels...
Just then, they hear a voice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Quick! We need to...

options.label: Come up with an excuse for being there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I bet I can pick it up in no time.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, It's sweet that you want to help...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But it'll probably be faster if Kenji and I just do this ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't want to waste too much time on this. If we hurry and get through fixing Hector's van quickly, that will leave us with more time to plot revenge against Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on, Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Really? What's the ignition timing on an '86 Anaconda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's the difference between leaded and unleaded fuel?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: How do you change a flat tire?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, you don't even know how to change a flat tire?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I'm familiar with the basic principles...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sorry, man. 'Familiar' isn't going to cut it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just wanted to help.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. You can leave this to the pros. With Linda helping me, it won't take long.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww. thanks, Kenji. Sorry, Howard... But I think we'd better take care of this ourselves.
Hector, Linda, and Howard head to the Auto-Shop, where they find Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh! Hey. Um, hey, Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda... It's always good to see you. You don't come by the Auto-Shop enough anymore.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And... Uh. You brought Hector and Howard with you, huh?
After a quick explanation...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So can you help us?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well... Let me take a look at the patient.
Kenji examines the sound system.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Man, they really did a number on the party van's wiring... Not to mention this marshmallow goop everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But I can fix it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Especially if I have some help. Linda, want to give me a hand?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, sure! I'd love to. I had so much fun working on the float with you at the beginning of the year...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You should keep at it. You're a natural, y'know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kenji's totally going to use this as a chance to hit on Linda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, hey, why don't I help you guys?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't think that's a good idea. You don't really know your way around a car, do you?

options.label: I know a lot about cars.

nodes.text: As Steph and Steve disappear, Brendan and Hector come running up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry we're late... Brendan insisted on stopping at every single red light...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's the law! You have to stop at red lights!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Some things are more important than the law, Brendan! Like the prank wars!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, you guys are too late... The Wilson kids are already gone.
After Howard and Linda quickly explain...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That was it? That was Wilson High's big prank? I mean, it's pretty good... But I thought they'd be up to something worse...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's just call it lucky that we got off this easy, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now, it's almost ten. I'm going to head home. My guild needs me for a raid.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. I've got to get out of here. I've got... Uh... Plans.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Plans'? You're not plotting something, are you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No way! We got Alexei and Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right, man... But stay out of trouble tonight, okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right, right. See you guys tomorrow.
Howard dives out of his car and pulls Steph off of Linda.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You're too late!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, I had it under control! Why didn't you stop Steve?!
Howard looks over just as Steve pours superglue on the lizard statue and slaps a badger mask on it!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Take that, Lyle! With this fast-drying superglue, they'll never get the mask off!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great... Now our statue is ruined, and Wilson High gets the last laugh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You should have gone after Steve!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry. I was just worried about you.
While Howard and Linda are arguing, Steph slips off...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Quick, Steve! Time to get out of here!
The two of them run off.
Steve sprints for the statue...
But Howard dives out of his car just behind him...
...And tackles Steve!
Howard looks over and sees Linda pin Steph to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, Steve! What were you planning on doing to the statue?!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'll never talk!
Howard searches through Steve's bag and finds a badger mask and some superglue.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You were going to superglue this mask on our statue, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Get off of me! You can't prove anything!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just get out of here... And don't let us catch you on our side of town again!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Fine... Let's get out of here, Steph.
The guys finish putting the car together!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. I love it when a prank comes together.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I just wish we could see the looks on their faces when they walk in and find Alexei's car here!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll admit it... This is pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm actually enjoying this! Though I do feel kind of bad for contributing to this war...
The boys work on the car, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This doesn't look right at all.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We might have to cut our losses and leave Alexei's car in pieces.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man... Kenji's never going to let me forget this.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the prank isn't going to be half as funny... This car is in so many pieces, Alexei might not even realize it's his!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It looks like we just dumped a bunch of scrap metal in the gym... That's not even clever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, maybe if we just keep trying...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is it really worth all this work to pull off this prank?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're just contributing to this never-ending war...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, we didn't start the fire, Brendan. It was `always` burning.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, we didn't start the fire, Brendan. It was [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] burning.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's not how fire works...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And why do you keep talking about fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fire is nothing to be afraid of, my friend. It's what separates us from the animals.
Howard's phone beeps!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a text from Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Come quick! Wilson High is here!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've got to get back to Centerscore!
One quick drive later, Howard pulls up to Centerscore High. Linda is on the ground wrestling with Steph while Steve is sprinting towards the campus!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! Stop Steve! He's going after the statue!
The guys finish putting the car together!

nodes.text: Man... Kenji's never going to let me forget this.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the prank isn't going to be half as funny... This car is in so many pieces, Alexei might not even realize it's his!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It looks like we just dumped a bunch of scrap metal in the gym... That's not even clever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, maybe if we just keep trying...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is it really worth all this work to pull off this prank?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're just contributing to this never-ending war...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, we didn't start the fire, Brendan. It was `always` burning.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, we didn't start the fire, Brendan. It was [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] burning.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's not how fire works...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And why do you keep talking about fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fire is nothing to be afraid of, my friend. It's what separates us from the animals.
Howard's phone beeps!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a text from Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Come quick! Wilson High is here!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've got to get back to Centerscore!
One quick drive later, Howard pulls up to Centerscore High. Linda is on the ground wrestling with Steph while Steve is sprinting towards the campus!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! Stop Steve! He's going after the statue!
The guys put the doors on.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, it's starting to look like a car again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right! Now these parts go to the...
After a few minutes of work...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So far so good... Next... It's the...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, Brendan. You won't regret this. I think you might even enjoy yourself...
A few minutes later, in the Wilson High gym, surrounded by car parts...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. We just need to do what Kenji did, but backwards...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So these pieces that were on the top must go to the...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: However you feel about Wilson, we're a team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you, Brendan. You won't let your friends down.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think of this like any other competition... Like the Model U.N. or the Crosstown Games.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not really about the pranks... It's about coming together as a team and beating Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're right. I can't let you guys do this on your own.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay! Okay. let's do this.
Brendan steps up to the security system and plugs in his computer. He starts typing...
A few seconds later, the system blinks and goes dark.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There! Done.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh, that was actually a little bit fun...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Exactly! And this `isn't` my idea of fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! And this [color=#e23b3b][i]isn't[/i][/color] my idea of fun!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys, but I'm just not with you on this one.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'll have to do it without me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I respect your decision, Brendan. I guess I'll just have to do this myself.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here goes...
Howard takes Brendan's laptop from him and plugs it into the security system. He starts typing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe I'll just... Press this 'delete' key...
The alarm goes off!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, get out of the way!
Brendan quickly accesses the computer system and shuts off the alarm.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you even know how to use a computer?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I might not agree with this, but I guess I can't let you guys do this alone...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, don't do it if you don't want to do it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, what am I going to do if the two of you get shipped off to juvenile hall?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess I'd better help.
Twenty minutes later, Howard and Hector are outside Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hold up a minute, Hector. If I remember correctly, Wilson High's got a state-of-the-art security system... Complete with cameras.
Howard points to the security system on the door of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If we don't want there to be any evidence of what we're going to do, we need to disable those cameras.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry, I'm way ahead of you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, guys. Why did you want me to meet you out here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan! You're just in time. We need your help.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Help? Your text message said we were going to have a `LAN` party to play 'Warscrewdriver: Online'!
nodes.text_bbcode: Help? Your text message said we were going to have a [color=#e23b3b][i]LAN[/i][/color] party to play 'Warscrewdriver: Online'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... I lied.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I needed you to bring your laptop to hack the school's security system.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I had to beg my mom to drop me off on the Wilson High side of town! You know how much I hate coming here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why do you think I said we'd play your ridiculous War-whatever Online? I knew it was the only way to get you to come!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, Brendan, weren't you a little suspicious when Hector told you to meet him at Wilson High in the middle of the night?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You make a good point, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, sorry you had to bug your mom. I can give you a ride home. Hector and I drove here separately.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks. At least I don't have to explain all of this to my mom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, enough chit-chat. We're going to pull a prank on Wilson High, and we need you to hack their security system and turn off the cameras.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait, Hector. This is a bad idea. I'm just as upset about the party van as you are...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Since we're having this conversation, I seriously doubt that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're talking like we've got a choice. Even if we don't do anything, Wilson is just going to keep going after us.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: These are drastic times we live in, and they call for drastic measures.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Besides, you know what they say... You've got to fight fire with fire!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait a second. Wouldn't you just end up with a really big fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly! Let's burn that place to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Metaphorically speaking, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Meta-what? Look, Brendan, we don't have time for your fancy math terms. Whose side are you on anyway?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why does there have to be a side?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, calm down! Arguing with each other isn't going to solve anything!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hector's being impossible!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan's being a traitor!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys! Come on! This isn't about traitors and loyalty. This is about...
Later that night, Howard's asleep in his room... When he hears someone banging on the front door!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm coming, I'm coming. Calm down.
Howard opens his door, and Hector runs into the house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've got it, man! An even bigger and better prank!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But the prank war is over! We got them. Now we can...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You fool! You really think it could ever be over? No way!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We've got to keep up a relentless, never-ending string of pranks, each worse than the last!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, that's ridiculous! We can't...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry. I know what you're thinking, but I've got it all planned out. First, we're going to need ten gallons of ice cream...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then we get as many live grasshoppers as we can fit in a sombrero...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yaaawn! Who's at the door? All your shouting woke us up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's nothing. It's just Hector.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It sounded like you were planning a prank!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Only the most massive prank ever pranked!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We want in on it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't usually work with kids...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But for the two of you, I'll make an exception.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So what are we waiting for? Kel and I know a great place to get quick-drying cement.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, but we can't take too long. I've already ordered fifty pizzas to be delivered to Wilson High at 6:00 a.m., so we don't have much time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Wait! You can't...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait!
Hector getting caught up in revenge and teaming up with the twins for a life of pranks and mischief?
Wilson High will never know what hit them... But Hector isn't cut out for this kind of life! This can't be the good ending.
Do you really want this to happen? Try again and get a better ending!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. Who throws honey at people? It's so weird.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're right... It's messy, it's inconvenient... But it lacks Alexei's usual malice.
Just then, Alexei's car comes careening back through the parking lot, and Alexei hurls a bee hive right at Hector's feet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bees?!
The bees start swarming... Going straight for the honey!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Several bee stings later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, boys... And Linda. It's time for a little thing I like to call 'revenge'.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I declare... A `prank war!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I declare... A [color=#e23b3b][i]prank war![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now, we've got to come up with a plan for something spectacular that we can do to Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, we need something good, something they'll never see coming.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, you're into pranks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course! I taught my little sisters everything they know about pulling pranks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, No one goes after my girlfriend and gets away with it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww. Well, I'm in too! I'm tired of this Alexei guy thinking he can do whatever he wants to us and get away with it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about this... I don't want to get in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan, you're covered in bee stings because of that Wilson High jerk!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Besides, don't you remember what happened during the last prank war?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I heard Alexei kidnapped the school mascot, didn't he?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's nothing! Before that, there was the infamous 'Soccer Team Scandal', the 'Locker Room Lock-Down', and the 'Internet Incapacitation'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The 'Internet Incapacitation'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Alexei somehow managed to figure out my email address...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And then he signed me up for every spam list he could find!
Last year...

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You have 58,093 new emails.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `What?!` I didn't sign up for the mailing list for Download-Viruses-Now.com!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color] I didn't sign up for the mailing list for Download-Viruses-Now.com!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Hector! What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Error! Error! Initiating self-destruct!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... So that's why you can't use the school computers.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly. It took the school a week to get the computer lab back up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Alexei is always taking things too far... This year, we've got to teach him a lesson.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So what are we going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Hector, do you still have those fireworks I gave you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, yeah, I've got them in the party van... But... I was saving them for... Something.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard! What are you thinking?! Fireworks are way too dangerous to involve in a prank! What if you started a fire?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right, right. Okay, no fireworks. We don't want to take it too far. But we do want to do something cruel, something devious...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you know that big fancy fountain the Wilson kids are always hanging out by? I say we mess with it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: They won't be so smug when their fountain is a jiggling mess of bright green gelatin!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Do you want to make them a snack or make them `cry?` I say we repaint their parking lot...
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you want to make them a snack or make them [color=#3b78e2][i]cry?[/i][/color] I say we repaint their parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But we move the lines a foot closer together!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `And` arrange the spots to spell out 'LOSERS'!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] arrange the spots to spell out 'LOSERS'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard, since these `both` sound like bad ideas to me, I guess you're the tie-breaking vote.
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard, since these [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] sound like bad ideas to me, I guess you're the tie-breaking vote.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, choosing between Hector and Linda? I better make sure I pick the right prank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I say we...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now we just need to take it to Wilson High...
Kenji's phone beeps as he gets a text message.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh oh. Looks like you guys are going to have to reassemble the car without me.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Megan's swamped with car repairs at her place.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Car repairs?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: She's making some extra money helping people get their cars fixed up after Alexei's prank with the marshmallows.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Turns out getting melted marshmallows out of an engine isn't exactly easy.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So I'd better go help her.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But from the way you two helped out, I'm sure you can put it back together in no time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you serious? We'll never get this car put back together without you.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Look, I already completely took the car apart for you.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now it's time for the two of you to step up, all right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sure it'll be fine. The pieces, screws, and bolts are all sorted into the three main things we had to take apart.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Exactly, and we loaded them into the van in order. So, just do what I did... But backwards.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Right... No problem.
Hector, Linda, and Howard head to the Auto-Shop, where they find Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh! Hey. Um, hey, Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda... It's always good to see you. You don't come by the Auto-Shop enough anymore.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And... Uh. You brought Hector and Howard with you, huh?
After a quick explanation...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So can you help us?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well... Let me take a look at the patient.
Kenji examines the sound system.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Man, they really did a number on the party van's wiring... Not to mention this marshmallow goop everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But I can fix it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Especially if I have some help. Linda, want to give me a hand?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, sure! I'd love to. I had so much fun working on the float with you at the beginning of the year...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You should keep at it. You're a natural, y'know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kenji's totally going to use this as a chance to hit on Linda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, hey, why don't I help you guys?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't think that's a good idea. You don't really know your way around a car, do you?

nodes.speaker: Hector

nodes.speaker: Steve

nodes.text: The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man, I wonder what's going on at Wilson High right now... Alexei must be going crazy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We really pulled off the greatest prank in the history of the prank wars.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I had my doubts, but I'm glad we did it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that so?!
Officer Monte marches up to the guys.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've heard just about enough.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? We... Er... Didn't do anything.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's too late for you.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: One of the upstanding Wilson High students witnessed your vandalism!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You kids are coming with me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! But it was just a prank!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A `prank?!` This is a serious offense!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]prank?![/i][/color] This is a serious offense!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: People could have been hurt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're just lucky the fire didn't spread to the rest of the school...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fire? What fire?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't play dumb! The fire at the Wilson High library! You punks burned it down!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way! We didn't do that!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Lies! Get in the car.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait just a minute! What's your proof?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: We've got Poindexter here's fingerprints all over the security system...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And Bonnie and Clyde here left their prints all over the fireworks that they used to set the fire!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? That's impossible! Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector! Were those the fireworks I gave you? Is that what they were for?! You said you wouldn't use them on the prank!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? They... I...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is that why you kept talking about fire?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! I... I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean you can lie to us some more. Officer Monte, you have to listen to me. We `were` at Wilson High last night, but only to pull off a stupid prank.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean you can lie to us some more. Officer Monte, you have to listen to me. We [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] at Wilson High last night, but only to pull off a stupid prank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We didn't start that fire.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Look, kid, I have a sworn testimony that you three were at Wilson High when the fire was started.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Unless the three of you can provide airtight alibis for where you were at 11:00 p.m. last night, you're under arrest.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: At 11:00 p.m.? I... I was playing Warscrewdriver: Online...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was on a date with Linda!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's what I thought. Besides, a traffic cam caught a crystal clear picture of that 'party van' on the Wilson High side of town at 10:30 p.m.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?! Hector, you went back?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's enough out of you three. You two can't prove either of your alibis, and this kid doesn't even have one.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that means the three of you have a one-way ticket downtown! Get in the squad car!
Oh no! It looks like Centerscore High is in trouble...
But at least you helped the team hold their own in the prank war.
Did Hector really start the fire? Was it a prank that backfired? Will we ever get to the bottom of this mystery?
You'll have to wait for the next episode to find out!

nodes.text: The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man, I wonder what's going on at Wilson High right now... Alexei must be going crazy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We really pulled off the greatest prank in the history of the prank wars.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I had my doubts, but I'm glad we did it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that so?!
Officer Monte marches up to the guys.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've heard just about enough.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? We... Er... Didn't do anything.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's too late for you.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: One of the upstanding Wilson High students witnessed your vandalism!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You kids are coming with me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! But it was just a prank!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A `prank?!` This is a serious offense!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]prank?![/i][/color] This is a serious offense!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: People could have been hurt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're just lucky the fire didn't spread to the rest of the school...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fire? What fire?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't play dumb! The fire at the Wilson High library! You punks burned it down!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way! We didn't do that!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Lies! Get in the car.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait just a minute! What's your proof?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: We've got Poindexter here's fingerprints all over the security system...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And Bonnie and Clyde here left their prints all over the fireworks that they used to set the fire!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? That's impossible! Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector! Were those the fireworks I gave you? Is that what they were for?! You said you wouldn't use them on the prank!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? They... I...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is that why you kept talking about fire?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! I... I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean you can lie to us some more. Officer Monte, you have to listen to me. We `were` at Wilson High last night, but only to pull off a stupid prank.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean you can lie to us some more. Officer Monte, you have to listen to me. We [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] at Wilson High last night, but only to pull off a stupid prank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We didn't start that fire.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Look, kid, I have a sworn testimony that you three were at Wilson High when the fire was started.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Unless the three of you can provide airtight alibis for where you were at 11:00 p.m. last night, you're under arrest.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: At 11:00 p.m.? I... I was playing Warscrewdriver: Online...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was on a date with Linda!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's what I thought. Besides, a traffic cam caught a crystal clear picture of that 'party van' on the Wilson High side of town at 10:30 p.m.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?! Hector, you went back?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's enough out of you three. You two can't prove either of your alibis, and this kid doesn't even have one.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that means the three of you have a one-way ticket downtown! Get in the squad car!
Oh no! It looks like Centerscore High is in trouble...
But at least you helped the team hold their own in the prank war.
Did Hector really start the fire? Was it a prank that backfired? Will we ever get to the bottom of this mystery?
You'll have to wait for the next episode to find out!
But before we go...
Since you played a perfect game, we think you deserve a bonus scene.
A few minutes after Officer Monte leaves, Linda and Amanda rush up to the crowd of students.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! What happened to Howard, Hector, and Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Officer Monte just arrested them! I guess things got out of hand after I left last night.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It sounds like they took the prank war too far and burned down the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?! No way!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They must have been framed!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't know, Linda... Officer Monte said he had their prints at the crime scene.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But you were there with them! You know what really happened, right?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh, I left early, so I don't know what happened after we took Alexei's car apart...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You... You think they really did it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh... All I know is that Hector was dead serious about getting revenge...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know the guys were really into the prank wars...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I never thought they'd try something so dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I know... But Hector didn't even have an alibi! That looks pretty bad.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No matter what he was doing, if he wasn't setting that fire, why wouldn't he say where he was?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't worry, Amanda. Hector's a big boy. If he got himself into this mess, then he deserves to pay for it.
It looks like it's not going to be easy to sort out this mess...
But that's it for this bonus scene.
Congratulations again on playing a perfect episode! See you next time!
Be sure to check out our new Premium Content, `Hector's Guide to Girls`! Enroll in Hector's seminar, and you'll find out how to score a date the Surviving High School way!

nodes.text: But the next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What happened to the parking lot?! Is this... Tar? My car's stuck!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Alexei!
And at the lockers...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And so then I was totally going to wear a pink shirt, but I remembered that Taylor got super mad the last time I did that and...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Eek! There are snakes in my locker!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Alexei!
And in English class, Hector opens the door to leave and finds...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A wall of desks?! What's going on?!
After a very difficult day...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wilson High hit us with every prank in the book today.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't take another day of this, Hector. `I can't take it!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't take another day of this, Hector. [color=#e23b3b][i]I can't take it![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's just face it, guys. We lost this prank war. We lost big time.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right. There's nothing left to do but surrender.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not going to be pretty... But all we can do is beg for mercy and hope they don't humiliate us too badly.
Yikes! Centerscore losing the prank war to Wilson High? That's a terrible ending!
You don't want to leave things like this, do you?
Quick! Play again and try for a better ending!
